records.title: Ministry of National Defense announcement on disciplinary decisions
records.description: The public statement identifies former senior officials and describes disciplinary decisions and referral to military procuratorial authorities.
records.use_description: CMSI-N17 cites the announcement for Wang Houbin’s former role and disciplinary action. It is later corroboration for the former role of Yuan Huazhi examined in CMSI-N16.
